## fetchDefaultBranch {#symbol-function-fetchdefaultbranch}

```{.ts filename="TypeScript"}
function fetchDefaultBranch(
   owner,
   repo,
   options?
): Promise<string | undefined>;
```

Defined in: [packages/core/src/github/releases.ts:279](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-wizard/blob/9e1d548db38647717aaac1c74c40903ed965e8bc/packages/core/src/github/releases.ts#L279)

Fetch the default branch of a repository.

This is used only when no release, no tag and no registry entry give a
reference to install. A failed lookup returns `undefined`, so the caller keeps
its own fallback. A SAML SSO error is rethrown, because the user must act on
it, and a cancellation is rethrown, because the user asked the operation to
stop.

### Parameters

| Parameter  | Type                                                         | Description      |
| ---------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ | ---------------- |
| `owner`    | `string`                                                     | Repository owner |
| `repo`     | `string`                                                     | Repository name  |
| `options?` | [`GitHubOptions`](github.qmd#symbol-interface-githuboptions) | GitHub options   |

### Returns

`Promise<string | undefined>`

Default branch name, or undefined when the lookup fails

## normaliseVersion {#symbol-function-normaliseversion}

```{.ts filename="TypeScript"}
function normaliseVersion(version): string | null;
```

Defined in: [packages/core/src/github/latest.ts:51](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-wizard/blob/9e1d548db38647717aaac1c74c40903ed965e8bc/packages/core/src/github/latest.ts#L51)

Normalise a version string for comparison.

The string, after one optional leading "v", must be a version from start to
end: one to three numeric parts, an optional prerelease and an optional
build. Missing parts become zero ("1.2" gives "1.2.0"), the build is dropped,
and the prerelease is kept so that "2.0.0-beta.1" sorts below "2.0.0".
A name that only contains a version, such as "release-3", is rejected.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Type     | Description                 |
| --------- | -------- | --------------------------- |
| `version` | `string` | Version string to normalise |

### Returns

`string` \| `null`

Normalised semver string, or null if invalid

## resolveLatestTag {#symbol-function-resolvelatesttag}

```{.ts filename="TypeScript"}
function resolveLatestTag(
   owner,
   repo,
   options?
): Promise<LatestTag | null>;
```

Defined in: [packages/core/src/github/latest.ts:81](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-wizard/blob/9e1d548db38647717aaac1c74c40903ed965e8bc/packages/core/src/github/latest.ts#L81)

Resolve the latest tag of a repository.

The latest tag is the highest semantic version among the releases and the
tags together; the GitHub "latest release" marker is not used. Tag names
that are not semantic versions are ignored. Prereleases, by version or by the
GitHub release flag, qualify only when the installed version is a prerelease.

### Parameters

| Parameter  | Type                                                                             | Description                              |
| ---------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| `owner`    | `string`                                                                         | Repository owner                         |
| `repo`     | `string`                                                                         | Repository name                          |
| `options?` | [`ResolveLatestTagOptions`](github.qmd#symbol-interface-resolvelatesttagoptions) | GitHub options and the installed version |

### Returns

`<code>Promise&lt;<a href="github.qmd#symbol-interface-latesttag" style="text-decoration-line: underline; text-decoration-style: dashed; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-decoration-color: currentColor;">LatestTag</a> | null&gt;</code>`{=html}

Latest tag, or null when no tag qualifies
